name: folk
description: Connect folk to Fractal through its MCP server and access the operations exposed to the connected account.

interface.shortDescription: Use folk MCP tools from your Fractal workspace.
interface.longDescription: Connect folk to your Fractal workspace so your agent can work with relationship CRM using the tools exposed by the service. Available actions depend on the live MCP server and the connected account’s permissions.
defaultPrompt: Give me an overview of my folk workspace.
Find anything in folk that needs attention and explain why.
